meta.name: dotnet-verify
meta.description: This skill should be used when working with Verify snapshot tests in .NET projects. Use when updating verified snapshots after intentional code changes, accepting new snapshots, discovering verify tests, or troubleshooting snapshot mismatches. Trigger phrases include "verify tests", "update snapshots", "accept snapshots", "verified files", ".verified.txt".

copy.tagline: 更新和管理 .NET Verify 快照测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 .NET 项目的 Verify 快照测试并需要管理测试结果。
copy.tagline_en: Update and manage .NET Verify snapshot tests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Verify snapshot tests in .NET projects and need to manage test results.

howto.what: 当您需要管理.NET项目中的Verify快照测试时，Claude可以帮您发现测试文件、更新快照、接受新快照等操作。
howto.when: 当您提到“verify tests”、“update snapshots”、“accept snapshots”等关键词，或者需要处理.verified.txt文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我更新最近修改代码后的快照
say.note: Claude会执行构建、运行测试并接受新快照的流程。

say.text: 列出项目中所有使用Verify快照的测试文件
say.note: Claude会通过搜索代码库列出相关文件。

say.text: 接受某个目录下的新快照

howto.what_en: When you need to manage Verify snapshot tests in .NET projects, Claude can help discover test files, update snapshots, accept new snapshots, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'verify tests', 'update snapshots', 'accept snapshots', or need to handle .verified.txt files.

say_en.text: Update snapshots after recent code changes.
say_en.note: Claude will build, run tests, and accept new snapshots.

say_en.text: List all test files using Verify snapshots.
say_en.note: Claude will search the codebase for relevant files.

say_en.text: Accept new snapshots in a specific directory.
say_en.note: Claude will use 'dotnet verify accept' with the directory.
